text: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear start. I need a few facts only you have before the site can be built.
Please send these: What are the dates of Spark 2026, and can you share the list of events? For each one we need the name, category (like coding, robotics, gaming), day, time and room or hall. If you only have some of this now, send what you have.; What is the organisers' WhatsApp number, and what is the full venue address at Northfield College of Engineering (building or ground name, area, Pune); Which sponsors should appear on the site? Please send their names and say if they have tiers (like title sponsor or gold). Logos are optional.; What should the event sign-up form ask students, and where should sign-ups go.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.
@Requester Thanks, I have what I need. I've used 14 to 16 February 2027 as you wrote it, and your phone number and email exactly as given. The team will start building now.

@Adaptation Charter is recorded. Propose workflows for a single-file Spark 2026 site. Cover the schedule by day, events by category with fees, the registration form to spark2026@example.com, sponsors as names only, venue with a map link, and WhatsApp contact, with an energetic mobile-first look and image placeholders. Room or hall per event was not supplied, so do not show or invent one.
